Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first misidentified the Wanli Emperor’s father as the Jiajing Emperor (Zhu Houcong) instead of the Longqing Emperor (Zhu Zaiji). Since Wang Xijie (Empress Xiaoduanxian) was Wanli’s wife, this led directly to the wrong conclusion that her father-in-law was Jiajing rather than Longqing. The Planner then reinforced this incorrect lineage in subsequent steps, guiding the search toward confirming a false premise.
